Rufoschweinitzin is a fungal binaphthalene natural product. A specific native ecological function for BGC0002257 in X. schweinitzii is NR.
Shimalactones A and B were reported as neuritogenic fungal polyketides. Their native ecological role is NR.

Beauveriolides I and III are acyl-CoA:cholesterol acyltransferase inhibitors. A later comparative study found that beauveriolide production can contribute to virulence in a host-dependent manner across related entomopathogenic fungi; a universal C. militaris ecological role is therefore UNCERTAIN.
The products are oxygenated brasilane sesquiterpenoids and glycosides; a specific native ecological function in A. truncatum is NR.

Sporothriolide was studied as an antifungal metabolite; in-vitro work also identified a hydrolase activity likely contributing to producer self-resistance. The broader native ecological role remains UNCERTAIN.

Spiromarmycin showed antibacterial/antifungal activity but did not inhibit the resident endobacterium B001, supporting a proposed protective role for the fungal-bacterial symbiotic pair; ecological protection remains an inference rather than a direct fitness demonstration.
Hancockiamides are unusual N-cinnamoylated piperazine natural products. A defined native ecological role or validated therapeutic activity is NR in the defining pathway study.
Atranorin is a major cortical lichen depside in S. alpinum. The pathway study establishes its natural occurrence and biosynthesis but does not directly quantify a native ecological fitness function.
Calidoustenes are members of a broader drimane-type sesquiterpene-ester family with diverse reported bioactivities; a specific native ecological role of the drt locus in A. calidoustus is NR.
